term: presence at every supplied world and time
definition: AllTime h x means ∀ w t, h.IsAt w x t, for a fixed bearer x and History W B T with a shared time carrier T. World and time quantifiers are unrestricted; no modal accessibility, coherence with Ontic.ExistsAt or temporal order is implicit.
note: Exact member of the DEF-HISTORY-TIME-SCOPE vocabulary bundle. HISTORY-TIME-SCOPE-CONTROLS checks AllTime → Common → Worldwise and the finite failures of their converses. No sourced eternity or premise truth follows.
